question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Someone has ______ my pocket in the bus, and I have no money now.
solution:
The correct answer is **"picked."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Picked"** means someone took something from you without your permission. (किसी ने आपकी अनुमति के बिना आपसे कुछ ले लिया)

 
 
• **Example:** *He **picked**__ flowers from my garden.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the speaker had money in their pocket before, but now they don't.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**:* **Someone has __**picked**__ my pocket in the bus, and I have no money now. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Broke** doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **Looked** suggests that someone only looked at the speaker's pocket, but didn't take anything.
 
• **Tore** implies that the pocket was damaged, but doesn't address the issue of the missing money.
